question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The latch is _______, I cannot open the window.
solution:
The correct answer is **Jammed**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jammed** is used when something is blocked or stuck.
